title: What Is an Unreliable Narrator?
skills: identify signs of an unreliable narrator
analyze how unreliable narration shapes interpretation and suspense
alignment_note: Introduces unreliable narration and explains how a narrator's limited knowledge, bias, distortion, or dishonesty can affect a reader's understanding of a text. Supports point-of-view analysis, credibility evaluation, close reading, inference, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
